36. a) Douglas F. Marcelini 
b) 1830 West Ramsey Avenue
c) Private Citizen
e) Stated that if the Airport Spur is anything like the other "Interstate Highways" with regard to air and noise pollution, it is of poor design. Also stated that planners do not care about the residents of the area.
f) ---
g) Federal and State air and noise regulations have been continually changing and becoming more stringent over the last couple of years. The design of Interstate Highways prior to this time did not consider air and noise pollution to the same extent as today.
This document and the public hearing are evidence that highway planners are concerned with both the residents of this area as well as the taxpayer.
37. a) Mr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Perez 
b) 5713 South 21st Street
c) Private Citizens
e) Stated that there were other alternates to building the Airport Spur. Felt we should be more concerned with energy conservation.
f) Stated that other alternatives such as improving Grange Avenue from 27th Street to Howell Avenue and 6th Street from Layton Avenue to College Avenue are available.
Suggested energy conservation starting with decreasing the use of the automobile and increasing the use of mass transit.
g) These improvements are already underway or proposed and are necessary to handle local traffic Please see the response to Witness 28 on page 248.
Milwaukee County is actively implementing a Transit Plan which included the purchase of the Transport Company and the construction of park and ride lots at various locations around the metropolitan area.
